review_text:
We did this cruise with our family. The commentary with the history of Darwin was great & watching the sunset over the water was incredible! However the food was quite limited. The plates u r given are very small. U can help yourself to the salads but meats are served to u & u can only have 2 prawns 🦐 given to u, which was disappointing. We seemed to be cruising ahead of schedule so instead of killing some time out in the harbour watching the sunset we spent a lot of time around the wharf admiring the Ferris wheel!! While at the wharf we fed the fish 🐠. This was great, however what wasn’t great is what we fed them, WHITE BREAD!! This is terrible for marine life.
Doing so can put their health at serious risk. Bread contains gluten and yeast, which fish cannot digest properly. It also contains a lot of sugar, which is unhealthy for fish.
Far better to feed them
The fruits and vegetables that are generally alright to serve raw are bananas, plantains, pumpkins, pears, apples, carrots, potatoes and sweet potatoes. These should all be cut into small pieces before they are offered to the fish.
Overall we enjoyed the cruise but was disappointed in the food offered & the welfare of the fish.

review_text: A stellar and wonderful cruise if you're visiting Darwin, don't miss this one. We opted for the sunset cruise and it was a really nice time of the day, comfy & beautiful. If you're driving there's free parking right at the wharf. The boat had ample seating and a free welcome beer was so nice to start our cruise. The captain and his family were so nice and hospitable in taking good care of all of us, with a really informative guide of the waterfront & nibbles along the way. Our only regret was not taking the buffet option which looked really good and would have happily paid it if we knew how good it was. My daughter loved the fish feeding towards the end and we all left the cruise happy. Well done guys and keep up with the great work you're doing.

Not impressed, the expense certainly did not match the experience.  Aircon was a joke as was the food, too bad the food we got didn't match the food in the picture on the brochure, definitely would not recommend to our friends coming up in a few weeks..

By far the best dinner cruise I have done and a MUST do for any SOLO travellers!! For most solo travellers eating out isn’t always the best experience as most places don’t know what to do with you however this is not the case with the Charles Darwin buffet sunset harbour cruise!
Tonight I had the pleasure of sitting at my own table at the very front of the ship with 3 other solos next to me, it was great company while still making it about your individual experience and not turning it into a group booking - not to mention we clearly had the best seats on board!🤩
The food was great and all the staff were amazing! I do have to make a special mention to one of the crew tho - Lidia - what an absolute gem! Not only was she attentive to what anyone needed but she made the entire experience feel very personal! If she wasn’t working she would have made a great addition to the solo front row! 🤩🤩

Very happy. We sat up top and the view was beautiful. Nice music and generous platters with local produce. I had the gourmet and my daughter had the garden platter. If you love meat go for the gourmet one. The weather was calm and warm. It was lovely watching as the sun set and Darwin City lights began to twinkle. This is my third time (in a span of 25 years). It's a must for me when I visit NT.
Lidia was amazing! She went above and beyond to make our night memorable. She’s very personable and charming. Thank you for a wonderful evening 🤗

The sunset views on the cruise were absolutely beautiful and the boat ride was calm and relaxing. Staff were friendly and the overall vibe was really nice.
I really enjoyed the food but if I had to comment one thing it would be adding more variety – especially hot meal options would really enhance the overall experience and make it feel more like a premium sunset dinner cruise.
Overall my experience was great and I would recommend to family and friends.
Amazing cruise! Would highly recommend to all my friends and family. Gabby in the office was extremely helpful

Part of a tour package, we did the sunset dinner cruise on a Tuesday night.

Boat left Dock 3 & check-in was very quick, then shown to a window table on lower level.

Full bar service - apparently there was table service but easier to go bar. Quality of wines quite good. Lots of can/bottles to select from

Food was buffet style - prawns, kangaroo, barra, salads, veges - quite good  barra was excellent.  Good selection of dessert & some fruit.

Scenery was nice, pre & post sunset. Didn't get much commentary regarding where we were. Disembarking was quick.

Stokes wharf very convenient for transport & lots of restaurants/bars to entertain post & pre cruise

Interstate visitors, booked the sunset cruise gaze & graze option. Arrived early enough & followed instructions given to us to head to wharf 3, lots of people waiting with some having a dinner booking & others doing same as us. Boat has 3 levels -dining on 1st & 2nd level, G&G on the sun deck. Boarding was a bit chaotic with inpatient people & the walk down the jetty is very steep but has handrails & slip resistant tread, they managed to get everyone on board. Staff were all friendly & service was hectic for them in that first 30 mins or so with everyone wanting drinks given it was still hot in the afternoon. 6pm departure & around 7pm we had our individual gourmet platters, there was so much food on them, we could not get through it all. We sailed at a good pace & was able to enjoy all the sights along the way & staff were attentive to any needs.  Bar tabs finalised at your table & docked back around 8pm. Would highly recommend this sunset cruise to anyone looking for a great night in the water & wants to see the amazing sunsets the NT has to offer. We were staying at Adina apartments & we walked down to pier before & after cruise (10mins). Thanks to all the staff for making it a great cruise.

Really great experience cruising the harbour watching the sun set. We did the grazing option and it was really good. If you choose that, you get allocated a table on the top open deck, which was excellent. Peopleove around to get a sunset pic which is fine, although the wannabe influencers can be a tad annoying.  Definitely worth while experience.

To put it simply, the Charles Darwin Sunset Dinner Cruise felt like a floating RSL. If that excites you then go for it, you'll probably have a great time. If that doesn't excite you, then there's plenty of other places to try in town with a modern vibe and better quality food. Food was bland and wasn't any better than your run-of-the-mill low cost buffet. Boarding was inefficient; everyone was crowded around one person looking up booking details one by one on a tablet before allowing them to board. For a moment I thought we'd miss the sunset. It was explained clearly at the beginning that first helpings of food are staggered by the staff for crowd and food management, however multiple diners disregarded this and either helped themselves when it wasn't their turn and/or helped themselves to seconds before other diners who were patiently waiting had even been invited to have their firsts, and a staff member did nothing even after being notified. There is plenty of food so you won't miss out but it was frustrating to observe and took quite a while until we had food on our plates. I wouldn't do this again personally, but there is a certain type of person who would probably find it worthwhile.

Did the sunset buffet dinner cruise, lovely boat with wonderful staff. There could have been more hot dishes but we got full. Dessert was pretty good too. Apart from the sunset the boat itself does not venture far out.  They don't ask you when you are booking but there are a number of tables on the outdoor deck, see if you can ask for one.

Really enjoyed our cruise. We purchased the buffet dinner package and the food was amazing. I struggled a little with the heat but the staff gave out little fans which helped. Enjoyed our views and had a wonderful sunset experience.

Darwin harbour sunset dinner cruise travelled late March 2025 would highly recommend this experience. From the initial greeting by the customer care consultant to my on board welcome and service. Excellent atmosphere great dining and beverage options with buffet dinner. The team have attention to detail even catering for food allergies, gluten free, lactose free and other digestive intolerances. Duration approximately 2 hours sit back in spotlessly clean environment enjoy dinner whilst taking in the views from the Charles Darwin. Thank you for a memorable positive experience

I’ve been taking this cruise every year for the past four years, and I can confidently say that this year was by far the best experience! The crew was incredibly attentive, the food was exceptional, and the recent renovations to the buffet and bar were fantastic. I even had the chance to enjoy a delicious frozen cocktail! I’m already looking forward to coming back next year!

Did the buffet dinner cruise on 13 December. Staff were friendly and helpful. Sunset views were nice. Good variety of food. Commentary was advertised, however none provided. So as we cruised past all the sights, the lack of explanation as to what we were passing and its historical significance was severely lacking. As a result, 90 minutes in to a 2.5 hour cruise, we were more than ready to depart.

We did this cruise as an excursion (a daytime cruise) booked through our cruise ship operator.   On the plus side, the staff were friendly and helpful. the 2 1/4 hour cruise was right on time, windows were clean, and there was a very nice spread of coffee, tea, and cookies and small cakes included.   Rest rooms clean (but 9 steps down; this was communicated before booking).   Unfortunately, there really wasn't much of interest to see on the cruise.   There was commentary for the first 45 minutes or so almost exclusively about WWII's effects on Darwin.   Several buildings were pointed out, and that was it.   The harbor just doesn't have enough sights (or they weren't mentioned) to occupy 2 1/4 hours.   The boat headed back and there was nothing new to see for over an hour.   Not recommended.
Air-conditioning didn't last. Food nice but only average for the price. Staff great.

Sunset Cruise. The best place to see the Darwin sunset.
The boat was comfortable. The grazing platter was superb

We (party of 4) booked the Sunset Gaze & Graze cruise. This certainly did not live up to any expectations. Boarding was slow & disorganissed (why not just collect a 'boarding pass', instead of using a tablet to locate & check passengers off). The recorded commentary on the cruise was limited and at times incorrect (the Cyclone Tracy display at the Museum & Art Gallery is currently closed) and the food was the biggest disappointment. What should have been 4 platters morphed into 2 and didnt include items that were on the menu (no melon in the prosciutto, bread was a couple of dried bread sticks). On the top deck there is no direct access to the bar -have to wait for one of the staff to remember you are there!!

We did our third sunset cruise with these guys and were not disappointed. We did the "Gaze and Graze" package and it was well worth it.
The food platter was huge for the two of us and of great quality , we were stuffed after. Not often that food actually looks like the images online but this platter surpassed that.
Unfortunately the star attraction, Dave no longer does the commentary,he was so interesting,informative and funny. Now a " plastic" commentary is played ,very sad. Bring back Dave!!!
The staff were lovely and very attentive.
Well worth it - if you feel the cold take a warm top just in case the wind gets up when the sun goes down. That's a tip not a complaint.

We paid for platinum on the ghan train. This cruise was without a doubt the worst part of the trip. Our table was part of the last 6 people to get food. Most of which was gone because seconds had been served to others before we got anything. One server did bring over some leftovers before clearing off dinner to start dessert. They said we could go first for dessert if we gave up finishing our dinner. And then we had to pay for any drinks including soda. Norts was incredibly rude and spent his time surfing on his phone or yelling at customers and staff. If this isn't part of your ghan trip avoid if it is bring food just in case there's nothing left.
We did the graze and gaze sunset cruise. Great tasting platter and icecream. Plenty of food, friendly staff and informative updates. Would definitely recommend!

What a great night. Great service followed up by fine food which there is plenty and you definitely won’t leave hungry is just perfect. The peaceful boat ride makes for an excellent evening well worth the asking price of $116.

Loved this sunset cruise, wonderful birthday treat.  All the staff were helpful and friendly, had a great time, food was excellent.

Would be nice to hear some NT music stars like Jessica Mauboy, Baker Boy, stingray band etc, in the music mix.

Very disappointed with this Company. My Husband and I tested positive for Covid the day we were to celebrate his 86th birthday, on this cruise. We understand their cancellation policy and as they suggested, claimed on our travel insurance, less the excess of $100.  As we provided Medical Certificates, dated the day of the cruise, we thought a refund  of $100 (our insurance excess) was not an unreasonable request, as we had paid $277 for the cruise. However, the company has refused any refund and retained the $277.

I went to the Darwin Harbour cruises , for my birthday with my friends and it was awesome. The food was amazing, the service was fantastic.. and the cruise was great. We loved it.. planning to definitely go back.
Food was nice staff where great

Good experience, food was nice and they had gluten free option for our guests coming from overseas that was a nice touch.

Although the service was nice I was very disappointing by the fact that they didn’t accept cash, you can come back to me with every single excuse that is not very oriented towards tourism.

We did the ‘Gaze and graze’ option and for what we paid, it was very disappointing. For $121 each we got a below average platter that was full of very cheap tasting/looking food. It honestly looked and tasted like the cheapest possible option for each item was used (eg a cheap block of tasty cheese cut up, a jar of plain green olives that had zero flavour, chunks of rolled up ham that you get out of a packet etc). It felt like they were going for quantity over quality and it just made the food really unenjoyable when we knew how much we had paid. We then got a tiny tub of icecream to finish that my lactose friend wasn’t able to even eat and they had no other options. The whole experience was so disappointing, maybe the other experiences offered would be better, but I would not recommend the ‘Gaze and Graze’ option to anyone.
Great experience all round friendly best food and great sunsets to boot.

Saw this cruise “feeding” the fish with white bread.  Absolutely horrified that they don’t, at least, feed them with something nutritious.  I guess profit comes before environmental impact for this mob.
Did the roof top charcuterie and it was delicious! The cocktails were also divine and the service was attentive without being over the top. Absolutely recommend!

Harbour dinner cruise on the Charles Darwin was faultless. We booked the buffet dinner which was inside the boat and there was a wide range of food with seafood, hot food and salads. All the food was exceptional. I advised them when booking that my wife was lactose intolerant and as soon as we boarded the vessel the staff were already prepared to ensure that she would have oil with the bread and not butter and came across and told her which foods had got dairy products in. There were also hot and cold desserts. Good range of drinks to purchase. The service was very attentive. We cruised into the harbour area. Saw the sunset and could go out on the deck, outside. This was undoubtably one of the highlights of our trip to Darwin and I have no hesitation in recommending it.
We used the hop on hop off bus to get to the wharf for 5.30 and we used the shuttle bus back at about 8.30 to get to the lift and walkway but it is walkable in about 30 minutes from the CBD.

They call it all you can eat buffet, but you have to use the 1 plate and get all your food at once. Oysters were good prawns were frozen imports or days old soft. Hot food was horrible and just slops. Deserts were ok. Save yourself money and head to the all you can eat at mindl beach. You get better sunset views and food

Stunning night on Darwin Harbour Cruises. Service was exceptional, food delicious & great selection of beverages. The perfect way to showcase Darwin to interstate guests.

The small clips of commentary were the perfect addition to give some additional insight into the Top End’s history. Highly recommend to both locals and visitors to Darwin.
Good food and excellent service.

Absolutely magic….
We did the grazing platter which was ample for the two of us. Cocktail was yummy…! Service was attentive, prompt and friendly. Informative commentary on Darwin history added a nice touch but didn’t take away from the peaceful, scenic focus of the sunset.

Highly recommend 👌🏼
I only wish I could give it more stars!!  The food was delicious and plentiful.  The staff were attentive and amazing.  We couldn't fault the night it was truly very special.  Thank you to you all.

Had dinner on the Charles Darwin. Superb meal and to witness sunset in the Darwin harbour was brilliant.
Certainly worth the money.

I recently went on the Darwin Harbour Dinner Cruise and was extremely disappointed. Despite the high price, the selection of food was abysmal. Not only were there only three hot dishes available, but they were also horrid. To make matters worse, the rest of the food, comprising 90% of the offerings, was served cold. We considered ourselves lucky because we had a light snack before the 'all you can eat cruise,' as when we went back for seconds, all of the hot dishes were gone. We ended up eating garden weeds and overly salty pork cubes for the rest of the night.

Adding to the frustration was the fact that the boat was massively packed with over 100 people, all crammed into the tiny main cabin. People didn't even wait until everyone had gotten the chance to go up and grab some food, leading to chaos and a rushed, unpleasant experience. To top it off, the man in charge seemingly picked tables at random, causing additional frustration for my young son. Overall, it was a complete waste of money and a terrible dining experience. I would strongly advise against anyone considering this cruise.

Went on the cruise on the 19th of April

Highly recommend. Sailing aboard the Charles Darwin by Darwin Harbour Cruises was one of the most pleasant and relaxing experiences we've had in the Top End. We were beautifully looked after by Mia and Christian, the food was fresh and delicious and the views were stunning. We chose the Gaze and Graze Sunset Cruise and were able to access the top deck of the ship, which afforded us gorgeous views of Darwin and the sunset over the harbour.

Locals for over 20 years (between us), we loved being on this cruise. Sometimes you just need to see a Darwin sunset from the water to remind you we live in a truly stunning place. The food was delicious and plentiful, the staff were professional and friendly and thanks to the sunset gods for turning on a spectacular sunset for us. Would recommend to locals and visitors alike.

I booked this dinner cruise 12 months ago and was very much looking forward to dinner on the harbour, I phoned the day before to confirm my cruise only to find out that they knew nothing of my booking. The lady I spoke to blamed my booking agent and said there was nothing else she could do therefore I missed out, very disappointed with the lack of empathy and help. I look forward to getting my refund. 😌
Thoroughly enjoyed the Valentine's Day dinner cruise. Delicious food, excellent service and a beautiful sunset. Definitely recommend!

What a wonderfull experience!!! The staff was incredibly kind, the food was amazing too! With my boyfriend we took the cruise during the night for Valentine’s Day and we had a really great night. It included dessert, the cheesecake was sooo tasty. Good job everyone!!!

Must do in Darwin, these guys are a class act
All the staff were friendly, food was delish and beers cold well done!
Sehr schöne Tour mit ausgezeichneten Essen. Wegen Wetter viel der Sonnenuntergang leider aus. Getränke müssen bezahlt werden, Essen gibt es als Buffet. Die Nachspeise war köstlich
We had a lovely sunset dinner cruise, the meal was Fantastic and the scenery was perfect, this cruise is a must if you are visiting Darwin, 5 Stars , Highly recommended
Fantastic commentary and very informative thanks to  the captain  and Ella

My recent cruise with Charls Drawin Cruise was an exceptional experience. The friendly and accommodating staff made it truly special. They went out of their way to take photos of our family against the backdrop of stunning views, enhancing our experience.

The cruise became even more memorable as we celebrated my wife's birthday onboard. The crew surprised her with a beautifully decorated cake and heartfelt wishes, which was an unexpected and touching moment during our journey.

Charls Drawin Cruise stands out for its warm and dedicated crew. From the warm welcome with a refreshing drink to the surprise birthday celebration, it was a cruise that exceeded all expectations. We are immensely grateful to the crew for making this day truly extraordinary. If you're seeking a remarkable cruise experience, I highly recommend Charls Drawin Cruise. Thank you for the unforgettable memories.
The cruise was fantasic. The scenary, commentary, platters & service. No better way to see a Darwin sunset!
Beautiful experience with great food and smiley staff. I highly recommend seeing Diego behind the bar for a special off menu cocktail. The boat ride was very calm and the sunset was spectacular.

The cruise its self was lovely. Only short fall would have been how loud the running commentary (War history) was. We couldn't speak or hear one another for the first 20 odd minutes. We were travelling with someone who had hearing difficulties and this isolated her. Otherwise, great experience.

Visited Darwin 2nd September 2023 - that night we did the Harbour cruise- what a fabulous experience- the atmosphere was great and the buffet was enjoyable. The staff were very friendly & attentive really  enjoyed the friendly banter with Diego 👍he made us some amazing cocktails 🍸 overall a lovely night.

We had a really great night and food was delicious. Must've had about 3 dozen oysters and a hundred prawns. Yum! They accommodated our group of 13 with ease and we had a great spot on the front deck. Unless it was raining, or windy, I wouldn't sit anywhere else - perfect spot for a few beers and delicious food. Thanks guys!
Beautiful views! Great service!
Rude inconsiderate helmsman.

Went on the "Gaze and Graze Sunset Cruise" on Friday, 4th August. Had a wonderful night.  The Grazing plate was delicious and plenty of food.  The staff were very efficient and friendly.  I will recommend this cruise to anyone.

Seriously! Park the boat in front of the sunset where 1000's of people have travelled to see it! Then once I query your company give a cop out response that you've never experienced tides like this that has obscured the view? The captain stopped the boat in front of the sunset and once it was over mysteriously just moved on? You need a new captain who can manage a boat!

Pretty poor form from the captain on this one, arrogance at its highest. If the captain can't steer the boat more than 100 M from the shore completely blocking the view for about 1000 people he needs to be sacked. Absolutely disgusted with the arrogant behaviour of this company, who thought it was ok to park their two story boat in front of hundreds of tourists who had come to watch the amazing sunset at Mindil Beach. Shame!!!
Rob Booth, Adelaide.

Travelled from Melbourne to see the spectacular sunset at Mindil market that everyone raves about. Instead,  the captain cruised ever so slowly in front of the scene and all but stopped.  Every single person on the beach were mortified.  What a waste.  That boat could have been anywhere else on the water and it seemed a very deliberate act.  Poor form.
Poor form, blocking the view for everyone on the beach.

Just watched and listened to 1000+ people cheer the sunset, then boo The Charles Darwin cruise ship who moved directly in front of line of sight of the su set for all the people sitting on Mindill beach. Poor form, Darwin Harbour cruises, poor form!

This is the first time I have ever seen such disrespect for a whole beach full of people also there for the sunset to have it totally obscured by the boat. The whole beach were booing if you don’t believe me look at the photo posted. Shameful selfish behaviour
Cruise was good, very inconsiderate to park in front of thousands of spectators at the middle of Mindil Beach. Not very community minded.

Poor form. Absolutely no need to block everyone’s view.

Joined the cruise trip and it was great! I enjoyed the view of Darwin City and the sunset. It’s so beautiful seeing the sunset on the cruise. Clear sky and beautiful ocean.

The food is also great. I got seafood platters and the portion is generous.

The service is also excellent! The servers really know how to treat people or customers very nicely making it a very wonderful experience!

Cheers!

I recently had the pleasure of taking a cruise with Darwin Harbour Cruises, and it was an experience I won't soon forget. From start to finish, everything about the experience was top-notch.

First and foremost, the seafood platter was absolutely amazing. It was clearly made with the freshest ingredients, and every item was cooked to perfection. The variety of seafood on offer was impressive, and it was all so delicious that I couldn't pick a favorite.

The service provided by the staff was also exceptional. They were friendly, attentive, and always willing to go the extra mile to make sure we were comfortable and enjoying ourselves. It was clear that they take pride in their work and genuinely care about their customers' experience.

The cruise itself was a delight as well. The boat was comfortable and well-maintained, and the views of Darwin Harbour were simply breathtaking. The knowledgeable guides provided interesting commentary throughout the cruise, giving us a deeper understanding of the area's history and wildlife.

Overall, I highly recommend Darwin Harbour Cruises to anyone visiting Darwin. Whether you're a seafood lover, a nature enthusiast, or just looking for a unique and enjoyable way to experience the beauty of Darwin Harbour, this cruise is sure to deliver. The combination of great seafood, excellent service, and stunning views make it an experience not to be missed.
Amazing experience and staff are so friendly and helpful. We got a great table for a birthday and the food and drinks were fantastic. It really is a must do if your in Darwin for the dry season.
We love your pick up driver he was best and good laughs
We had the best time on the Charles Darwin and cannot recommend this cruise highly enough. We opted for a grazing plate on the Sundeck.Celene really looked after us and was so accommodating.
Excellent. Great commentary from the skipper. Excellent smorgasbord. Feeding the fish was a highlight.

There are lots of ways to enjoy the spectacular sunsets over Darwin Harbour, but Darwin Harbour Cruises gives you a ringside seat! We enjoyed their Gaze and Graze Cruise, which included a platter of nibbles. Yummy and stunning! Thanks team for your hospitality. Much appreciated.
Had the sunset cruise. Fantastic experience with great service. Views of the sunset were magical!

Fantastic 2-hour cruise aboard the Tumlaren; friendly, attentive crew and great commentary; delicious charcuterie box meal (also offered prawns and oysters from platters) and a good range of drinks to choose from. Beautiful sunset and great view of the coastline. I enjoyed being able to walk
around the boat. Definitely recommend!
Had a lovely meal in pleasant surroundings. Nice way to finish off the day.
Fantastic cruise on Sea Darwin, staff were friendly, highly recommend

We opted for the Charles Darwin Sunset Cruise with a platter, rather than the full dinner buffet. As we had preordered the platter, a table on the sun deck was reserved for us.
Right from arrival, everything was very well organised, being directed to the deck, the table, ordering of drinks and the delivery of our food.
We had the cheese platter, which had a great selection of cheeses and plenty enough for us to share.
The staff were very friendly and helpful and the delivery of the commentary was really good.
Unfortunately there wasn't much of a sunset for us, but we had a great time anyway.

This is the second time we’ve been on this sunset cruise first time was in 2015 and this was the best experience we’ve had and was looking forward to it again so on the 13th November we booked it and wow I don’t know what’s happened ,the commentary was good , but the food was absolutely disgusting , it tasted like 3 day old hospital food, since our first experience the trip has obviously grown in the number of people it takes which has resulted in poor quality food.
Definitely worth doing. Great dinner cruise of the harbour. Food was nice and there was plenty of it. Commentary was good but the volume needed to be lower. Staff were great 👍

What amazing experience! Must do in Darwin .Thank you . This is our second time on this cruise and you’ve always delivered. Thank you to the crew & chef. Will definitely back again for 3rd round. Hopefully soon . Keep it the good work !
Gabby, Diego and Toby are a credit to the team. Had a wonderful experience. Food was amazing and will definately do this cruise again
Got placed on the foredeck outside for dinner.  But windy to start with but calmed down and was perfect. Food was great, commentary was quirky and sunset was stunning.  Thoroughly enjoyed it all

Definite must do in Darwin! Happy accident for gaze & graze on upper deck which had quality ample food, fantastic views & photo opportunities. Nort, on commentary was hilarious, made safety briefing most enjoyable! Loved it.

The concept of this cruise is "Enticing", however, our expectations were far from met.  Admittedly our tour was booked via Imagine Tours, not by ourselves, so we were unaware of options for inside outside seating & what that meant regarding food choices.  On arrival you all just stand on the dock, the gate opens, you file on, nothing orderly about it.  Then when you enter, you are advised that you will be seated inside, taken to the table.  Ours was by windows, with stack of outdoor chairs & a timber wooden partition, plus dirty windows (all around).  After asking the stack of chairs was halved.  We were unaware of steps down to toilets, my sister had mobility issues-but managed. The commentary was just a drone of annoyance & some relaxing background music would have been appreciated.  The commentator was like a parrot repeating what he had said a thousand times.  No ebb or flow & hard to hear.  We all just checked out & struggled to talk over him.  The staff did not keep the buffet plates stocked swiftly enough.  The commentator picked & chose which table went when.  The food was say 7/10.  One of the bowls on our table had clearly not been cleaned properly.  Bar service seemed reasonable after the initial rush.  The asian staff member stood out positively.  The table cloths were clean, the tables beneath chipboard with lifting laminex.  Large cracks in toilet floor.  However, the concept & possibilities to have a wonderful evening were there but lost in amongst the other.  I think it would be time enough for the commentator to drone on, after the sunset.  It was like lets get through all the good stuff in the first 1/2 hour.  After the sunsets - it is just dark - apart from the beautiful Ferris Wheel lights.  Orderly loading, like front deck/1st level etc. could help.  By the time we got back to dock, we all just wanted off.  If we had been seated in a half decent place, with windows we could see through, be welcomed (that bit was OK), then chill with the sunset and wine, I reckon a lot of the rest would not have even been a noticed.
Great way to experience Darwin's stunning Sunset on the water,fabulous staff and beautiful buffet style meal.relaxing...

Highlight of our time in Darwin - worth the $, fantastic service, everyone so friendly boarding and exiting (employees seem so happy), platters were excellent (recommend ordering in advance as you book your tour, your food will come out very quickly), and the mango ice cream to finish was delish. Tour guide at beginning of the ride was great, good to learn some history and then kick back and enjoy the remainder of the cruise and the sunset washing over the boat. A memorable experience which we will recommend to others.

What an awful experience
Went on board clearly telling them I have an anaphylactic seafood allergy. Was rung up day before to confirm and I told them again - happy to go elsewhere if they could  not accomodate me. When on board very rude captain instructed me what I could eat - pointing out the prawns and other seafood. I repeated again I can’t eat that as in I’m allergic and he told me I could have the barramundi or anchovies. I ended up having salad and chicken. No idea if he thought this was funny but as it is a medical condition my husband started to get very worried.  As the evening progressed I had to ask the waiter to move away from me as they had a bucket of prawn scraps. Also food scraps on the floor. Ended up waiting to dock outside because of the seafood smell and scraps everywhere . Terrible experience - would not recommend.

We had a lovely night on the water.They gave us a good table at the bow of the boat.The staff were very attentive, cleaning tables when you were finished. The toilets were a problem for me because i am disabled, as you had to go down a flight of stairs and there was no disabled bars,so I had trouble in toilets. The food was alright.I think it is better to go on a night cruise when it is NT night as you see all the fireworks. Once the beautiful sunset had gone done,there wasn't anything to see..

If you're looking for an amazing venue to celebrate a special milestone then THIS IS IT. For my hen's/bachelorette we hired the Tumlaren and it was an AMAZING experience. We hired this amazing vessel on a Thursday night and I got married on a Saturday - it was such a great decision. We had the captain (Lyle) with the support of Kristy create such a special evening. Together we sailed the coastline of Darwin watching the sunset and listening to our favourite tunes. My bridesmaids organised some amazing games and we had a phenomenal time. The cruise provided us with these gorgeous grazing platters and sparkling wine, soft drinks etc. This is a 10/10 experience and if you're umming and ahhing just make the decision and go here. It's an experience you'll remember for the rest of your life.
Great cruise excellent buffet friendly staff great commentary plenty of food or hand always replenishing.  Reasonable bar prices and great views of the harbor and sunset.
Wow what an experience with outside dining on the deck with friendly staff an commentary. Great variety of seafood and vegetables dishes to suit everyone, sunset was spectacular.  Highly recommend.
Terrible awful shocking. Booked months in advance for 15 people and you kicked us off cos you over booked AND refused to refund our money.  I don’t recommend this company at all. Thanks for nothing.
Great farewell cruise
Wonderful cruise friendly efficient staff. Particular mention to the girls Taylor & Stephanie who were so helpful with giving me a quiet & cool spot away to breastfeed & put Bub off to sleep.
Lovely cruise and good food. The only negative thing was that for the price I did expect a complementary drink. Sorry forks buy your own, water on the house

Good food and good experience. I didn't like the attitude of one of the waiters (the blonde one), he was the whole time swearing words to himself but it was obvious that you could listen to him, I think if he does not like the job, he shouldn't be doing it. The rest was very good
Loved the experience
Excellent cruise. Happy friendly staff. Good food.  Great views and narrative. Value trip for all.
Great activity to see the harbour. We were lucky to have the sunset and the full moon rise within 45 minutes of each other!! I definitely recommend this experience for any visitors!
Very good service. Should have no smoking policy on top deck especially when you are surrounded with kids and families.
This was absolutely stunning and the buffet was gorgeous 🌞
Good food.  Pleasant staff.

Paid for the $100pp dinner cruise. Disappointing is an under statement. World rather spend the money on a fancy restaurant meal. Actually, I would recommend eating at a water side restaurant instead and enjoy the view. Three Disappointing reasons: 1. They pack the boat full of people which means there is no real viewing space and you feel like you're intruding on other guests space when trying to take in the limited daylight. 2. The 'captain' had a random way of determining which table goes up to grab food that you paid for - felt like I was back at school and the teacher chose their favourites to go up first. With absolutely no logic, you somewhat feel he plays favourites as he wants to be. Not happy. 3. After sunset about 40 minutes into the cruise, it is dark for the remaining 2 hours. Not much to see. The only good point was the seafood was fresh, but then again you can get that right at stokes Hill wharf (where you board the boat) at a fraction of the cost! The cruise is one thing to avoid.
Great food and service
We had a great cruise on Monday night, lots of food including prawns and oysters.  Beautiful sunset too, would highly recommend.
Many thanks to the office staff for reorganising our booking when our itinerary got disrupted. The cruise was well run and the food was wonderful. A great and relaxing  experience.
Excellent service, made sure as a coeliac we were catered for wonderfully which made for a great evening on the water. Staff went out of their way to make our trip special.
An excellent cruise with great commentary
An amazing cruise with spectacular views and food. I was lucky enough to be seated on the bow/deck and loved every minute. Totally recommend this cruise.
Nice staff and best food
Loved this cruise
Great trip and really nice platters
Great way to see a famous Darwin sunset. Food was excellent with a good selection. Crew were friendly.
Food options not great,  paid for transfers from hotel,  not given option or awareness of free shuttle
Amazing! There's nothing quite like Darwin sunsets and what better way to take it all in than with a seafood dinner?!? :) well priced and worth it!

So incredibly underwhelming... and I'm being kind. If you've never been on a boat or done a sunset dinner, you'll probably think it's OK. But this is no Hamilton Island sunset cruise. Good food, great service!
Great cruise and service. Amazing team on board.

$72 for children, $110 for Adults.

We were the second last group to be "allowed" to go get our meals. When my sister told the gentlemen the kids were starving - his response was we were not present for him to let us go up. We have also been on Spirit of Darwin as a family group, and had a lovely time! Entree bought to your table. RELAXED and very COMFORTABLE cruise. Two drinks included.
Had a great cruise at Darwin Harbour on our holiday. Food was good, guide was very informative, friendly and humorous, nice relaxing cruise.
Amazing Food, Amazing Staff (Norts is hilarious and Tony absolute legend) Love Love Love. Would do it again :)
Great evening, food was excellent and lots to choose from. Staff were friendly.

Was okay, but meal basic, we think quite expensive overall.
The commentary was bit off putting, the guy was trying to be funny in between the serious part of maybe needing to put on a float vest.
No check was done either  where we came from. Didn't see any sanitiser.

We had the best experience on the Charles Darwin harbour cruise tonight. The atmosphere was great, the dinner was delicious and generous, the staff were amazing and knew the history of Darwin. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Great value for money, we will be back 😁

We used our tourism top end voucher and took a family of 5.  Amazing and efficient staff, always had a smile on their faces, very helpful. We weren't disappointed with a beautiful sunset either. We did the buffet dinner cruise and the food was abit fancy for our kids but what they did eat was delicious. As an adult we thought the food was nice.

My husband and I booked and paid for the sunset cruise, the food choices had not really interested us so we did not book the meal or platter option. Nothing against the staff or business, just not our idea of a relaxing sunset cruise, particularly at the moment with social distancing and all that biz.

Fantastic cruise food was delicious well worth going on. David thankyou for your service and commentary and to all the crew.
It was a  great experience would definitely recommend.

My husband and I went on the Charles Darwin Sunset Buffet cruise on 16/10/19. We loved the experience! Booking process was easy and staff were so lovely and polite. The food was tasty and it being a buffet we were able to go for seconds. The crew member who gave an overview of Darwin's history and landmarks on the top deck was just a delight to listen to; very engaging and funny. Overall we had a great time and would recommend it to others.
A great experience,  exceptional food and wonderful customer service from the staff.
Excellent service and stuff!!
Beautiful cruise at sunset! The crew were friendly and helpful, the food was delicious and the view from the bow deck was amazing! We had a wonderful trip. Highly recommend this cruise.
Seadarwin awesome cruise with a beautiful sunset

This is one of the best experience during my solo trip to Top End. The weather was pleasant and I was able to soak up the peace and tranquillity of the sunset with loads of photo opportunities. The crew member was passionate and provided us an in-depth commentary about the city, history, culture and landmarks, which is one of the perfect ways for someone visiting Darwin for the first time. The buffet itself was great, with a variety of mains, salads and dessert. In addition, all staff members are very accomodating and friendly, which made the entire journey much more smooth. Overall I have enjoyed it to the fullest and I will recommend it to others.
what a great commentary they have
Five star treatment by staff 😊unfortunately weather conditions forced cancellation of the package  we were doing 😩😩

We (4 of us) purchased the $58 option, i.e, without the buffet. I think the cruise is great value for money and the people are nice too. The cruise is spacious and ample room to walk around. Nonetheless, the sunset is worth every $!

Great cruise in general, one of the main things we were concerned about was food running out. However with it being a buffet they always replenished whatever was out. Dinner menu on the buffet line included:

Seafood: Oysters, Northern Territory tiger prawns, picked baby octopus, Seared Reef Fish
Non seafood: Mango chicken & rice, seared beef, Roasted Vegetables
Desserts: Assortment of Cakes, seasonal fruits

However overall we thought it was great value for the price we paid (buffet sunset dinner).
We had the best time! Great sailing and relaxing time, thanks to the crew for fantastic service as well. 👍

Not the best available in the area. Do a bit of homework first. Food reasonably good. Drinks not too sure about their measures. Cruise easy going. Perhaps better management on board might off set issues
Chill out & take in the panorama

Great cruise however very disappointed with main meal as we were last to get served and they had run out of most of food....however made it up on the sweets.....just not good enough when u pay good money....
Marvelous cruise

All of our national and local guests enjoyed a taste of Darwin and commented on the night and afterwards that it was an "incredible experience" they absolutely loved the food, service and cruise. Amazing sunset cruise!!! Amazing stuff on board. Amazing service. As soon as we step on board cruise staff made everything to make us feel comfortable.The boat is excellent. Would like to recommend everybody as a part of holiday in Darwin or just to have nice dinner and enjoy amazing sunset. )))
Great night food very good. Down stairs you can't hear the commentary or understand what is being said.
Top cruise & informative operators.

We enjoyed our cruise on the Charles Darwin, the staff were very efficient and friendly, the wide variety of food was excellent, the captain gave us a very informative talk on the way out around the harbour, we chose to go on this tour for our 50th wedding anniversary and were very p,eased with the night.  Well done.

I loved the sunset dinner cruise! The boat was nice, the staff was very friendly and gave a great overview of the Darwin area as we sailed out. I had read bad reviews of the food but I thought it was really pretty good. There was a salad, oysters, prawns, steak, chicken, seafood, grilled veggies, and dessert! The sunset was just amazing! We had lightening storms off in the distance. I really enjoyed my evening on the cruise and I think it's a must do for Darwin visitors. Now that I live here I plan on taking friends and family on it when they visit.
Would recommend this to all visitors to Darwin,  my family really enjoyed the  experience.
We got married on their sunset cruise, great friendly service, beautiful sunset and an absolutely memorable experience
Place to chill

Did the Charles Darwin Sunset Buffet Dinner cruise. Food was good but not exceptional. Fish had no flavour. Deserts were the best part of the food. Drinks reasonably priced too. Boat was nice and smooth. If you want to sit outside, I'd request it when booking as the bow deck is limited seating but the Air conditioned interior is just as nice.
Don't waste your money on the food, worst meal I have ever had. Go on top deck then after have a meal at dock

And silly me didn't take a camera ....it was just great, and my only problem was that cruising around the Darwin Harbour, I didn't have a clue where we where when it got too dark to see. unable to comment on cruise,however, no service by  phone,internet or office on Sunday.
Unfortunately the owners have let their son run this into the water. Arrogant, rude, not customer service focused. Get a skipper who is customer focused and friendly.

We absolutely loved our experience sailing on Kuru for a hens night, a gorgeous way to start the night out on the water. Spacious boat and very friendly and helpful crew. From booking through to sailing it was a fantastic experience and I highly recommend sailing with City of Darwin Cruises!
Spent a fabulous night on the Darwin Harbour on board the Kuru.. This sailing catamaran is awesome, lots great spaces to sit and enjoy the sunset. Can highly recommend Les and the team..

Our family spent the afternoon on the amazing Kuru for a special event. Thank you for such a perfect cruise. The crew were fantastic, booking was a breeze. The boat was accessible for the elderly members of our family. Perfect afternoon. Thanks so much.

The company prioritise locals over tourist, even stated this through email. We were a group from the USA and had an awesome time.  Crew was awesome and helped make a special occasion even more special.  Would highly recommend to anyone!  Thank you to the crew for all the efforts!

Loved it.
Been coming to Darwin for work for years and cannot understand why I have not done this before.

Absolutely loved this cruise.

Thank you City of Darwin and hope to cruise with you again soon
Excellent.   Fantastic coming back in the dark and seeing the city lights and lighting storms.

The crew were welcoming and warm.
This is our first time together visiting Darwin this experience was wonderful.
The beverages and canapés were more than filling. We paid for dinner option truly delicious, do not go with a full stomach. This experience was worth every dollar. The ocean views, the beverage options, the food just book. Thank me later. To the crew we apologize we kept to ourselves but we are very esoteric. This did not mean we didn’t enjoy ourselves. The team is a solid 11/10. Thank you.
Sailing ⛵️ On the Kuru was fantastic. Thanks to Les for the booking ease and Jevin and  Austin for a fantastic trip.
Nice cruise. Nice staff.

Fantastic Darwin Sunset Sail on a great boat - not too many passengers which made it more intimate.  Great drinks and nibbles and the best music. Loved being able to sit in the nets out front and chill out.
Sailed on the Cherry pie with my family, everything was very organised and clean. The host and skipper on board were very friendly, highly recommend.

City of Darwin cruises provided a sunset sail charter for our Bachelorette party. They were really great to deal with for the booking process and we had an amazing time onboard. They even upgraded our sailing boat to their new boat. Thank you guys for the great time.
Sailing across the bay, no motor, friendly crew, plentiful drinks and nibbles, highly recommend.

All of it was nice.
I've seen reviews saying there wasn't enough, but, it wasn't an issue for us. Perhaps, some context or reality checks by those reviewers, but that's their thoughts so onwards and upwards.
Nicely sunburnt and crispy as the sunsets, gave an opportunity to David Bailey up, and phones a plenty were out - probably with many fingers and thumbs taking centre stage.
I didn't go the fruit salad for dessert but again, just by sight ( having a quick butchers around other tables) there was plenty to go around.
You could take your own drinks, but there was a list of beers, wines and soft drinks at bar prices. If you've splurged on the cruise make it an adventure and buy some house drinkies.
I'm sure Grace (hostess) gets fed up running up and down the steep stairs, but she's a natural at this hospitality business.
Any gripes? My wife wouldn't tell me how much it was, so probs not cheap; I couldn't hear the music, or more importantly the capitano spiel as I think a speaker had died.
Look it was a treat of sorts, and so any cost must reflect that (apparently it was about $150 ea).
It is also run out of Darwin Harbour in the top end. There's no place for Italian loafers (Roberto worked hard) or channel no 5.
There are other cruises run in purpose designed vessels, but this had history, and the cruises are now part of it. So, steep steps and low walkways aside, give it a go. Treat a special one, and you may get more than just memories on your return.

Entree was buffet style 3 types of seafood - beautiful Coffin Bay oysters that were so fresh you could still taste the sea. Prawns in their shell and smoked fish which was also very good. Diners were asked up by table and considering the limited space this was a good idea.
Mains were steak and fish. I asked for a rare steak and was very happy with it. Rare was the way to go as the steaks were on the thin side but a good size. Both dishes were presented with no garnish. Salads were available at the buffet. First suggestion, a salad bowl served to the table would be more appreciated rather than stand in a cue, steak in hand, waiting for space at the salad bar. Extra plates in a small kitchen but worth the added comfort factor for diners.
Then there was dessert. The biggest disappointment of the night. Cut up fruit at said buffet!  Very reminiscent of a day trip to the reef including lunch. Individual cheesecakes or something similar served to table would have been better appreciated. And seriously, for $155 per head, would have been more in keeping with expectation.
The boat was licensed and the limited selection was fine and bottle prices $40 to $45. Sensible pricing for dinner on board.
