Excellent, beautifully cooked food, beautiful boat, bit of a mission going downstairs to the toilet on the steep stairs!! A few trip hazards but if you're careful, they are well dealt with.
No doof doof, comfy chairs, quick service, tasty plentiful food, excellent smooth cruise, gorgeous sunset, perfect service.
They even allow you to BYO soft or alcoholic drinks! Eskies provided!
Great value for money!!
We had a beautiful meal and cruise whilst watching the sunset and views of Darwin.  Staff were attentive and foid was delicious.

Really a great cruise. Food was excellent as was the sunset. Staff are friendly and quite helpful. Fully licensed or byo and they provide the ice bucket and chilled glasses.
Would highly recommend this cruise.

Had a memorable cruise for my girlfriends birthday. Our seating on the upper deck gave us an amazing view of darwin harbour and its beautiful sunset. The staff were amazing and the food was superb. Thank you for providing us with an amazing experience.
Great little dinner cruise. Fun capable crew

Over priced and under delivered

Food was of very poor quality and quantity.
We asked for a top up of the entree buffet as there was not much left by the time we got there-mains arrived before this happened.
Fruit platter was a joke-one slice of watermelon and one slice of orange.

There was no commentary at all.

Don’t waste your money.

Don't select the prawn platter food option. The prawns were soft and mushy and seating was directly behind the galley so you spend the cruise breathing in cooking fumes. Service also suffers in these seats as the focus is serving the guests on the forward and upper decks.
Food - delicious. Sunset - beautiful. Ship - comfortable and decent space between dining table/ groups. Staff - exceptional!

I took a group of 12 on this cruise. Molly was amazing in organising everything for us. The food was ample and delicious. The staff were fantastic. The cruise was memorable and to top it off it was BYO. Highly recommended.
MAREE’S Tours
What a wonderful NIGHT. Food was great, sailing was calm and comfortable and top staff. Many Thanks.

We had a great time during our cruise. The cruise started with the first course of fresh prawns, fresh Coffin Bay oysters and some salads. The quality of the food was excellent. The main course was a choice of steak or freshly caught jew fish. We went the fish and it did not disappoint. Great size serving with more self serve salad, prawns and oysters.  The third course was a disappointing self serve fruit platter. This was a bit of a letdown after two great courses. The boat travels out from Stokes Hill Ward turns right and follows the coast. The sunset over the water was spectacular and most enjoyable. The boat makes a slow cruise back to port. The boat is smooth to ride in. I recommend this as an enjoyable dinner option.
Great experience , great value, beautiful salads, oysters and steaks ...loved it

Was a fantastic sunset cruise. We had the prawn platter which was beautiful.
Thoroughly recommend.

If you want a relaxed, leisurely evening, with delicious food, and welcoming, friendly Staff, look no further.
Loved every minute of it after a very busy day.
Can’t recommend highly enough-will be going again when we return to Darwin.
Booked a cruise with these guys in September. The only thing I could fault was the music playing. Needed to be a bit more upbeat and vibey.

Absolutely delightful! The staff are great, the boat is beautiful and the sunset gorgeous! It was my birthday and they even brought out a surprise slice of cheesecake. One of the best cruises I have been in! ❤️
What can I say. Staff amazing, food flavoursome, captain awesome, music perfect. I wouldn’t listen to any negative reviews at all. They made our honeymoon special.
Lovely calm cruise, staff friendly, professional and very efficient, seafood and variety of salads very tasty.
A great experience.  Molly bent over backwards at booking  to ensure our trip was perfect.  Sophie and the rest of the crew were fantastic.
A lovely sail and craft, however the quality of the food let the evening down. My wife's steak was very poor quality. There was little salad left for the main course. Service was attentive.
Second time doing this cruise. Great food and atmosphere. Highly recommend

A enjoyable evening cruise, service and food was fantastic. 3 of us had the steak for mains and one of us had the fish - good portion size and plenty of other food to top it up. It was beautiful being out in the water to view the amazing sunset, a very relaxing evening

I chose the 4 course meal sunset cruise
It’s amazing what the chef produced from a boat galley
Salads oysters prawns and choice of steak or fish
Sunset in style
The staff were amazing

Had a lovely night on the Cape Adieu dinner cruise. The staff were great , the food was excellent, plenty for everyone.  The salads were beautiful, whoever prepared them did  a great job.  The main was white salmon, with a Mango salsa Verde. It was so beautiful.  Top marks to all involved. We loved it...highly recommend.

Perfect! Perfect! Perfect! This cruise was seriously good. The food was delicious and plentiful, the staff were excellent and the Darwin sunset did not disappoint. The smaller boat meant a more special occasion. Molly and Jemma were fantastic. Thanks Cape Adieu for a lovely cruise.
Lovely crew, great food, relaxing cruise.
Went on the Charles Darwin sunset cruise, it was FANTASTIC, the boat the staff the menu the commentary, we loved it all.

Pleasant ship. Crew very upbeat. Was very unhappy about almost being bullied into having the salmon, which wasn't particularly nice, instead of a steak.  The most expensive of the cruises and had hoped for better.

A must do dinner harbour sunset cruise in Darwin.
Great staff, food was fabulous.
Able to take own alcohol.
Highly recommend.

Incorrect location, Cape Adieu is docked at Stokes Hill Wharf dock 3.
There is also a ticket office located there too.
Nice light breeze, gentle cruise along the Arafura sea. Sunset was spectacular, especially after the sun had dropped. Food was surprisingly good and drinks were reasonable price

Just an amazing cruise, from the moment on board the crew are friendly and provide excellent and professional service.
Food is fresh and full of flavour, and the views are exceptional. Highly recommend.
Great fresh seafood, professional & friendly service, with a calm sail, even with the storms !!
Fantastic food, great service
We have been on this cruise twice now and it is great value.  The staff are friendly and attentive.  Seafood is devine!  And my steak was done to perfection.  Cape Adieu never fails to satisfy.

We enjoyed a wonderful Cruise with a friendly, helpful staff.
Would highly recommend Adieu Cruises.

Everything about this outing was excellent. Excellent relaxed and welcoming vibe from all onboard. Great food, including fabulous fresh seafood  and reasonably priced drinks. BYO is also welcomed.. Darwin does great sunsets and seafood, and what better way to experience both, than on a cruise in the Darwin Harbour!
Highly recommended
Absolutely enjoyed the experience. The food was fantastic. The service was brilliant.

Great cruise environment. Cruise staff were really lovely and informativem. Great value for money and went for just the right amount of time. Just paid for the cruise no meal but the food looked really nice
Had a fabulous night, staff super friendly, food pretty good, sunset wonderful.  Thanks guys, night to remember
Great staff.   Perfect way to spend a hot evening

Excellent value. Very friendly and professional staff. Boat was comfortable, stable with minimal engine sound. Went for the prawn platter option. Very tasty dips, prawns and fruit and tea/coffee provided. The commentary was informative but plenty of breaks to allow time to just take in the view and chat with my cohorts.  Topped off with a really great sunset.  A highlight of my Darwin holiday. Highly recommende.
We did a dinner cruise last night and I could not recommend it more highly.  The atmosphere was lovely and the food was sensational.  BYO makes it veryaffordable. Will do  again.
Loved everything about this cruise, highly recommend.
Can not speak highly enough about this experience. Food was excellent,  staff are amazing , the view spectacular.  Wish I did it twice .

This is an Outstanding Life Experience, while enjoying great Gress local seafood and a good available drink selection while you cruise the calm Darwin Harbour to enjoy the amazing Sunset. Super Highly recommended.
Absolutely fantastic great meal and great service. Would highly recommend to anyone. To do. Thanks very much Mike and Bev Smith 👍🍻

I took my beloved 90yo nonno on this cruise with the prawn package and I must say...it exceeded my expectations! First, the staff is absolutely lovely and super friendly. Second, the prawns were plenty, super fresh and delicious. It was a relaxed 3 hour experience where I created great memories with people I love and he (the fussy one!!) was really pleased. Absolutely recommended.

My family would like to thank you for a memorable time. Beautiful night, accompanied by fresh seafood served by attentive and courteous staff.  Only one negative – maybe you could change your background music to something a little more suitable. Throw in a few Australian songs rather than Bob Dylan and Simon and Garfunkel. Why not try Reckless by Australian Crawl, Great Southern Land by Ice House, Throw your Arms Around Me by Mark Seymour, My Island Home by Christine Anu, One Country by Midnight Oil or pick any song by Paul Kelly.  Your cruise showed how stunningly beautiful our country really is, so why not play some Australian classics?   Thank you.

We had a fantastic night with Cape Adieu Harbour Cruises sunset cruise with amazing locally caught fresh seafood. Would highly recommend for dinner to see Darwin from a alternative aspect and have a lovely dinner at the same time. Staff were very helpful and friendly!
What a awesome dinner cruise great food great atmosphere and can't fault the staff totally recommend a must do when in Darwin
Very well run. Delicious dinner.  Great staff. Sunset was a bonus
Not to be missed. Thoroughly enjoyable. Great boat, great service, fabulous team. Sensational value for money, we loved it!
Great boat, service with a gorgeous sunset

Awesome cruise, food , service and communication of the highest level. Would recommend highly and would do again. Nothing was too much trouble even though the stafff were very busy getting all the meals out. Great play list Matt 🙂

We had an absolutely fabulous time on this cruise last night.  The welcome  we received upon boarding was so friendly.  Our hostess got us settled in, organised an ice bucket and glasses for our BYO bottle of wine.  Then, she got some ice for the BYO beer in our little esky.  Nothing was too much trouble.  Nibbles arrived --yummy homemade dips--as we departed the wharf!  A bit later, it was time to hit the buffet for 'entrees'.  The seafood was fresh and plentiful.  The salads were varied and also nicely presented.  Later, after the beautiful sunset, we received our main course--again with the option of salad on the side.  Finally,  fresh fruit and coffee was offered!  Amazing value, great organisation, lovely scenery to watch on the way, good commentary, wonderful service--who could ask for more!
Best night on the water for a long time. Excellent.👏👏
Loved this evening.  Plenty of food, including prawns, oysters, smoked mackerel and salads. The staff worked continuously with a smile on their face.
Staff were professional. Food delicious

Very imformative and professional.
We were on the upper deck and avril did an awesome job looking after us .
We would highly recomend this as a must do cruise in darwin.

Just enjoy and relax with sea breeze on your face. Food is nice too, from entree to desserts.
All the staffs are very friendly and smiling, looks like they love their job.

What a fantastic cruise. Down to earth really friendly staff. BYO option! Food was reasonable, heaps of cooked prawns and fresh oysters. Steak an option for mains. Would absolutely do this cruise again.

We had a fantastic evening celebrating my husband’s birthday. The staff were most friendly and very attentive. My husband received cake and sparkler unexpectedly. The food was amazing. Sunset superb. Really enjoyed the small, intimate atmosphere, and being close to the water. Would do it all over again.
Tonight Dinner.
Amazing cruise, great food lovely staff

Summed up in one word
BEAUTIFUL
Loved it
A beautiful evening out!
Great experience. Highly recommended. Captain Shane and his crew are awesome. Make certain that you book a dinner option.
A fantastic evening from start to finish. The food was good and the service we received was excellent. A great experience to soak in the glorious Darwin sunset.

Had a fantastic evening out on the Cape Adieu. Terrific sunset, and really good food - the highlights being the prawns and oysters for us! Enjoyed the skipper's commentary as we cruised around the harbour. BYO is a huge plus!
Thoroughly enjoyed the cruise experience in Darwin. Food ok....but a bit overrated
A fantastic night had by all. The crew are amazing and what a Great cruise.

Highlight of our trip to Darwin.

We loved this cruise! The staff are very attentive and you can BYO drinks. The food was superb…. We got talking to the captain and were amazed to find that they build their own Smokers for the Smoked Mackerel they serve onboard. They also cook the Prawns onboard!!!
A relaxing 2.5hrs on the harbor with an amazing sunset to match. It was the Highlight of our trip to Darwin.

Highly recommend this cruise if you ever visit Darwin.
Very enjoyable and relaxing. The food was great and the staff were helpful and friendly. Absolutely recommend this tour.

Nice cruise, nice food but a bit over priced. Experience was ruined by yobbos smoking and swearing at a 22st birthday on the cruise. Offered free drinks was nice but did not make up for the annoyance.

What a fantastic evening we had great service and food not to mention the beautiful sunset.
We were very well looked after by Chrissy who worked her butt of to make sure the evening was as pleasant as it was.
Would do again if ever back in Darwin.

We went on this sunset cruise for a birthday dinner. It was Sunday night, and I thought it might be busy, but it was very well organised, and didn't feel crowded. The boat itself was quiet, no engine noise. I chose Cape Adieu Harbour Cruises because of the dinner menu. We were not disappointed. We are planning on staying in Darwin for a year, and loved the service, food, and cruise so much we will probably do it again in a few months. Delicious oysters, smoked Spanish Mackerel, Banana Prawns, Red Fin Salmon. The boat is licensed, but it is also byo. Staff were friendly. Thank you to all staff.

Had an amazing time! Took my friend on this 2.5h cruise as a surprise and we were both so happy about it! The food was delicious and we had the option to BYO as well! Cant stress enough on how lovely our italian waitress was. Thank you again for the perfect evening. Would definitely recommend this cruise to everyone.
A great 3hr cruise with excellent food (smoked Spanish mackerel to die for) and great service from the crew money well spent .
A beautiful night out. The boat is small enough to feel intimate, food was delicious  (especially the oysters and banana prawns) and the fact it's BYO makes it even better.
A great time

Great night out!
We came onboard to celebrate my wife’s Birthday and it was such a memorable experience, a night we won’t forget! From start to finish we were greeted with smiles and great customer service. The staffs were attentive but not intrusive and the food was delicious! We had 4 courses, the seafood was outstanding especially the Smoked Mackerel, Salads were fresh & tasty and to top it all off the Homemade cheesecakes for dessert were Splendid. They even put a Sparkler on my wife’s dessert and greeted her Happy Birthday!

We sat on the front deck and had an amazing view if the Sunset, the captain turned the boat around just as it set so that everyone on board had a good chance to take pictures.

BYO is allowed and they even put your drinks on ice for you.

If you’re ever in Darwin this is a Must Do!  :)
Rude arrogant owner and bad food, don’t do this one
Excellent food nice staff great trip
Beautiful evening out, not rushed at all. Lovely fresh produce...casual relaxed atmosphere
Wonderful  wonderful what a great night. A must do again one day
Great service. Great boat. Great seafood - more than you could possibly eat. Great value. Highly recommend.
Superb! Seafood was generous and delicious
Had a great trip around the harbour - very relaxing.

I organised my engagement party with these guys and it was absolutely fantastic. We had friends and family come up from down south and they were extremely impressed.
Matthew was the main person I corresponded with, and he was always extremely helpful, accommodating and punctual with replying to my many questions.
The food was brilliant as well, the chef seemed a bit young when I first saw him, but he definitely knows what he is doing, every course was amazing.
The other staff and the captain of the boat were just as fantastic as the others, really helpful and happy to answer questions, bring drinks over to people (we brought all our own drinks) and even help out the younger members of our entourage; my little brother had trouble with his steak and without a word from anyone, one of the staff members was cutting up his steak for him.

The night was absolutely fantastic and I cannot fault these guys on anything, thank you so much for such a memorable night!

The cruise was very informative and the sunset was lovely.However I don't think the buffet meal was value for money. Only 4 salads, one being tinned baby beets and another couscous.  The other two were nice but they ran out by the time the main course cane round. Only one dessert which was a small crumble which I liked but it would have been nice to have a choice. $92 for seniors not worth the money

My sister and her husband were visiting Darwin and we took them out on a sunset cruise on the Cape Adieu. It was the most wonderful night - we were seated on the top deck at the stern and had a wonderful view, delicious food and excellent music interspersed with informative commentary about the sights we sailed past. The weather was perfect and the crew were organised and attentive. This was the best outing we have ever had in our 2 years in Darwin. We will take all our visitors on this cruise in future.

I did the half day tour, visiting the bunkers at Charles Darwin NP, the ww2 Darwin bombing museum & harbour cruise.
Mariet is so knowledgeable about the attack and also took time to tell us about historic buildings on the way around. She also got the museum people to run the video presentation as soon as we arrived, to free us up to see the rest of the exhibits.
I had difficulty getting to the city for the 8am start (stayed out of town, missed bus, hitchhiked & walked) and Mariet was very kind and flexible, communicating well in helping me to join part-way. She even offered to take me back to the bunkers at the end, to cover the bit I missed.
The bunkers and museum are must-sees and the only improvement i could suggest is more time in the museum, there's a lot to see and learn about. Tho I acknowledge there's a schedule to catch the boat which other people do separately, so there's time pressure.
On the cruise David was very entertaining and it was great to get out on the water to see the city from a different perspective. There's actually not a lot of ww2 stuff to see out there, but the stories were great.
A long review but can I add big thanks to Lucy and Mariet for fitting me in and giving me a superb morning.

We went on an absolutely amazing turtle tour with Sea Darwin-Sea Tiwi. One of the best wildlife experiences I have ever had and can't recommend enough. A really special place and experience, it was an honour to see the turtle mums laying their eggs and a few little hatchlings that hadn't made it out with their siblings, the beautiful bare sand and stars as we waited for them to come out of the water.
The process around not disturbing the turtles as much as possible was fantastic and the meal on board was healthy and delicious.
Apart from this we were absolutely humbled by how amazing and lovely the crew were. I was quite pregnant on the trip and would have understood if they declined to take me (particularly given how limited these spots are), instead they went to an extraordinary effort to accommodate me, including changing boats, and were so lovely about it. I felt quite embarrassed to have caused such effort but extremely grateful. The trip was an absolutely sensational experience and so grateful to have been able to go and experience such a special part of the world. Thank you very, very much to everyone involved.

We went on the Turtle Tracks tour. What an experience! The crew were extremely knowledgeable and respectful, looked after us extremely well and made sure we had an awesome time. Couldn't fault the tour. It is an experience not to be missed.

Our group enjoyed the Fish and Chips Sunset Cruise!!  Fish and Chips were nice and fresh, drinks cold and staff friendly.  We would have liked it to be more informative.  The staff obviously know all the information, as they were talking to different people and ourselves if we asked questions, but if they were announcing something it was very hard to hear.  A suggestion of having a microphone so there could be a running commentary of the areas we were seeing, and that way everyone could hear too.  Thank you we enjoyed ourselves

Loved this sunset cruise. The fish and chips were fresh and hot, the drinks cold and the crew friendly and knowledgeable. Great mix of tranquility at sunset  with a bit of speedboating on the way home 👌🏻

Did the WW2 by Land & Sea half day tour with Ferry cruise. Picked up at 8 am from esplanade accom with first stop at Survivor's Lookout nearby, then a sight seeing drive through city, premier Bayview & marina suburbs, paspaley pearl origins & checked out Darwin National Park with its hidden ammunition bunkers & scenic lookout. Followed by the WW2 Bombing of Darwin ferry cruise. Then East Point area drive past plus 1.5 hours stop at Darwin Military Museum. Finally dropped off where we wanted to be - Darwin waterfront Stokes Hill wharf. About 4.5 hrs tour - think I have covered it order of sequence..

Enjoyed it all -  guide & driver Trevor was informative & obliging with a welcome esky of icy bottled water which I felt like dousing myself with to cool off..🤓

On the harbour cruise, lucky us got to ferry past the majestic & biggest aircraft carrier in the British Navy - HMS Prince of Wales which had docked only 2 days before for a large scale military exercise with multiple nations. Port of Darwin & naval base flies under the radar in history & in the news but was & is a strategic defence base. Darwin Harbour is 60 x bigger than Sydney Harbour.

This guided tour & cruise was an eye opener & by the time my first visit to Darwin came to an end, I transformed into an enlightened Darwin devotee!

Ferry cruise included Anzac bikie handout & 5 mins bobbing over the sunken grave of WW2 casualties. A small TV screen in front of ferry showed sonar imaging of these vessels which made little sense & those at the back wld have visually blanked. A poignant Remembrance moment totally lost on us.

Instead of this meaningless offering - how about projecting an actual undersea video of these WW2 sunken ships a la Titanic & request a minute silence in remembrance & then distribute the bikies? A larger TV screen is needed. Can you Sea Darwin - this wld be a fitting tribute..👌🏽👌🏽✨️✨️
Honestly, this was the absolute best trip. Highly recommend!

We thoroughly enjoyed the sunset cruise. The fish N chips were fresh & delicious, the bubbly chilled and pleasant, the crew were very welcoming and hospitable. The actual trip was great fun and the views picturesque. Thanks for a lovely night.
This is a great package. Harbour cruise was great with funny informative guide. RFDS display was excellent. A easy stroll back to the Waterfront then up the steps to the Main Street.
We had a wonderful experience with a pair of knowledgeable guides who care a lot about showcasing the turtles in a respectful way.

A disappointing tour tonight, with almost no talk by the crew on where we were on the harbour.  While the sunset was pretty, we felt so sorry for people seated on the "wrong" side as the boat was never repositioned to enable
them a close up of the view.
The crew would answer a question or two from guests and the rest of us had to eavesdrop to gain any local knowledge.
The team here could take some lessons from the Tamanian teams of Bruny Island cruising fame.
The fish and chips were nice.
A group of us from Melbourne went on a cruise with Gavin,Mary and Kate, what a great experience, we found Gavin and the girls to be friendly and informative and we all enjoyed ourselves immensely.

The Bombing of Darwin cruise on Anzac Day morning was an unforgettable experience. Super professional staff, the commentary was relaxed and deeply knowledgeable. It was very moving when they gave us an Anzac biscuit with John Schumann’s Anzac Biscuit song playing. Very highly recommended.
We had an amazing afternoon on the sunset cruise with Gavin and team. He was super friendly, easy to talk to and ask questions and made the trip enjoyable. Thank you again!

I was really looking forward to this trip but unfortunately it did not live up to my expectations.  There was no interaction between the guide and customers.  It was delivered in a monotone voice. If one passenger had not asked how the wreck was found we wouldn't have learnt about diver who found it. Sorry guys but totally not worth money.

We did the WWII bombing tour, and where to begin - firstly, we could barely hear the guide throughout. Instead of having a microphone that works with the boat speakers (which we know work thanks to the lovely Glenn Miller we heard), they have bought a cheap karaoke machine which kept cutting out. Expecting an interesting history lesson, we were instead met with a monotone guide, telling the story with no real flow and zero inspiration, failing to ask if anyone had questions and not really interacting with the group. My personal 'favourite' part of the tour was when we were told we were going to a shipwreck - I thought we'd see parts of the boat sticking out of the water, perhaps some rusty masts. Instead, we were at the site, tilting our heads up to look at a screen of an infrared map to 'see it on the seabed'... it looked more like a mountain than a boat. To quote my mother, "the only part I enjoyed was when the boat went fast." It's no good seeing the sites of the action if the commentary going along with it is uninteresting. I really do not think this was worth the over $100 paid.

We had a magical night aboard.  Captain Jim and gypsy were awsome. We left on time, had an amazing feed of fish and chips. The Territory sunset was like nothing I've seen before.  Truly unforgettable.  The whole trip was seamless.  Would do the sunset cruise again.

Excellent tour of Darwin Harbour with information on the bombing of Darwin in WW2 and then a short visit to a croc trap. Julia and Gavin were excellent guides and we thoroughly enjoyed the experience learning such a lot in a short space of time. Would recommend this tour as a start to a visit as it puts a lot of the important places on land into context. Sorry not to have had more time in Darwin

We attended 2 tours with Sea Darwin in August; Bombing of Darwin tour and Turtle Tracks.
The Bombing of Darwin tour was fab, very informative and engaging! Betty took us around in the new bus, I think she was more excited than us! Great tour and great guide.
Turtle tracks tour - I think this is the best tour I've ever been on. Our guides were brilliant, so knowledgeable and respectful of all the wildlife. We saw about 40 tiny turtles emerging from their nest, a beautiful thing to witness! Because it wasn't dark enough to release them, they were put in a canvas bag and given to my partner for safe keeping and warmth! So sweet. We then saw a mama turtle dig a nest and lay her eggs.
Releasing the babies under the milky way was an experience I'll never forget.
The boat ride back included food and drinks, which were lush!
We'd highly recommend Sea Darwin for their tours, and if we're ever in the Top End again, we'll be sure to book another 😊

We did the Turtle Tracks tour to Bare Sand Island and had such a wonderful time…..lucked in with a turtle coming ashore and also hatchlings making their way out of their nest!
Big thanks to Nat and Ella for their incredible knowledge and commitment to the turtles and to Kerry for his boating skills!

Amazing Experience 100% recommend!
We took the Turtle Tracks tour to Bare Sand Island. Kerry, Emma and Julia took great care of everyone from the very start of the trip.  Following a fun boat trip or to the island we hopped off to discover an island full of beautiful sand dunes.  It wasn't long before Enma found a nest that had recently hatched. Upon checking there were a few stragglers left behind. A bit further up the beach a hstchling was being hassled by sea gulls. All 4 babies were released to sea. We were also lucky enough to see a female lay her eggs and create her body pit before heading back to sea.  The sunset was glorious and the stars! So many.   Thanks for a great trip!

What a great affordable trip around the Harbour, great experience, excellent fish and chips, sunset for the romantics and little bit for the adrenaline junkies thrown in, the crew were first class and very informative, a must do if in Darwin.

Thank you so much, Sea Darwin Sea Tiwi crew, Carolyn, Emma, Kerry, and Bare Sand Island team for an incredible trip to Bare Island. Just everything we had hoped for: great information (so interesting), flatback turtle mums being perfectionists as they chose the best place for nesting, soooooo cute hatchlings, a crocodile masquerading as a log, a glorious sunset, lots of turtle heads bobbing in the sea waiting till it was safe to come up, a glorious moon, such stars, and delish food.
Good luck with plans for Sea Tiwi. #SeaDarwin, #SeaTiwi, #see turtles and recommend everyone to see you.

We had a great tour with Kerry, Carolyn and Emma. They were very welcoming and passed on a lot of information about the turtles, which was very interesting. We were extremely lucky as we saw the old man crocodile, turtles hatching, turtles laying eggs, almost a full moon and the Milky Way. The fast boat was fun. A special experience and worth the money.

They canceled our boat last minute and were all out of seats despite us booking months in advance so we watched from the shore.  Poor management on this occasion and need to give these people a miss. Very disappointing.
As apologetic as this company has been, we were still shafted and missed our tour while others who booked later than us managed to get theirs. We watched them go out on another boat from the beach. Not good enough. Sorry.

Yesterday evening we ventured with Sea Darwin out to Bare Sand Island for the turtle nesting. From the moment we stepped aboard the crew was amazing and never stopped looking after the passengers, with insights, general chat and ensuring everyone was comfortable and enjoying the trip.
Once on the island, our minds were blown!  We lost count of how many turtles we saw wandering up to the dunes to lay their eggs.  The knowledgeable team were very respectful of the turtles and ensured we all stayed out of sight of the turtles, while we witnessed every step - from digging the nest and then the the egg chamber, laying the eggs, re-covering the nest with sand and heading back into the water to swim off into the sunset.  It was amazing and the knowledge of the team was next level. We learnt so much and can’t recommend this trip enough…. Oh and did I mention the meal and drinks that were served, absolutely delicious.  Thank you Sea Darwin for a fantastic evening

All the team at Sea Darwin were fabulous! Big thanks to Lynda for coordination efforts and skipper Adrian for bringing the vibes! Can’t recommend this tour and company enough for your Darwin adventuring 🌈🚤🤙
We did the 1 hour harbour cruise with Kerry and Julia as our hosts.  Fantastic local knowledge and history with good humour thrown in.  A quick trip well worth doing!

Schöne Hafentour, Adrian und Danny sind die extra Meile gegangen und haben sich die Zeit genommen für eine Gruppe Delphine zu stoppen. Generell gab es genug Zeit um zwischen den Sprints Fotos zu machen. Man sieht alle Gegenden des Hafens inclusive Mangroven und bis ca. Mindil Beach. Das Boot ist ein großes Schnellboot mit Sonnenschutz. Es gibt eine Bar an Bord und sogar ein Klo. Die Ganze Fahrt wird mit Kommentaren begleitet.

Captain Adrian and his crew, Kate & Carolyn were fantastic! Greeted with a beverage on boarding and enjoyed the beautiful fish n chips while taking in the sunset. Adrian passing on his local knowledge which made for a great experience.
Highly recommend! Awesome experience. Team on board very informative very friendly. Good was delish. Adrian is a great driver and host

We went on the Bombing of Darwin Tour in the Wet season, which was hot but its in a covered canopy boat so that doesn't matter! The tour guides were very friendly and chatty and really interesting to listen too. Loved it!

I did the half day WW2 by Land and Sea tour with my teenage son. This was an excellent tour and one of our best experiences in Darwin. The tour goes to key sites from the boming of Darwin including a harbour cruise. A visit to the Darwin Military Museum was included - this was one of the best museums I've ever been to for its size and I want to go back for a longer visit. Highly recommended if you have a free half day in Darwin.

Ik heb de Turtle Track tour gedaan. Heel gave tour waarbij je de flatbacks kan zien nesten op het strand. Voor zonsondergang hebben de gidsen eerst een net uitgekomen nest voor ons uitgegraven om te kijken of er nog schildpadden waren die niet uit het nest konden komen maar wel in leven waren. Helaas geen geluk. Maar het was wel interessant om dit te zien. Daarna toen de zon onder was zochten we een schildpad die kwam nesten. Na even wachten kwam ze het steand op en begon rustig met een plekje vinden voor haar nest. De gidsen (die overigens heel veel kennis hadden over de schildpadden (PhD))  volgde dit van dichtbij tot ze begon met graven. Toen mochten wij ook dichterbij komen om het te zien. Wit licht en veel beweging zou de schildpadden storen/afschrikken in deze fase van het nesten dus het was dan ook erg jammer dat een aantal touristen zich niet aan de instructies hielden en er soms toch ergens een wit lichtje aan ging (hoe moeilijk kan het zijn denk je dan). Maar goed, toen de schildpad klaar was om haar eieren te leggen gebeurde er iets (of de gids deed te vroeg haar witte licht aan of er viel zand terug het nest in) waardoor ze besloot een heel nieuw nest te maken. Het vergt veel geduld deze tour omdat het erg lang duurt voor ze een goed nest heeft gemaakt en klaar is om de eieren te leggen. Maar de gidsen en de schipper wachtten het rustig af en gaven ons extra tijd om het toch helemaal te kunnen zien gelukkig. Ik vond het in elk geval een prachtige eraring! Heel bijzonder om dit zo in alle rust te mogen ervaren. Al het geduld meer dan waard! Juist het geduld en de rust maakt het ook zo bijzonder

Even though the moon turned out to be more glamourous than the sun (clouds got in the way at the worst possible time 😂) it was a brilliant, fun experience worth every penny. We will definitely be back on board! Thank you Sail Darwin!
A wonderful evening and sunset tour. We enjoyed it very much. Great thanks to Skipper and team for the perfect service and wonderful tapas dinner!
Such a relaxing night and we were spoiled with great food, drinks and service.  A wonderful night and well worth the price.  Highly recommend!

Sail Darwin on the Sundancer catamaran was a wonderful evening - the sparkling wine was beautiful, the range of food was delicious and seemed to just keep coming round. Yet I didn't feel like I'd overeaten! The weather was perfect and the scenery stunning and ever-changing. The sunset was beautiful with plenty of time to take photos and enjoy the colours. I don't think I could have enjoyed the cruise more, thank you!!
Went on the sunset cruise with my family, it was phenomenal, my 15yr old daughter also loved it, loved the food, the eclectic range of music, something to suit everybody

Brilliant experience. Free flow bubbles (and I mean free flow!), great food (the zucchini and halloumi snack was a masterpiece), great company on board, experienced skipper and crew and, to top it off, a wonderful sunset (with a switched on skipper who did a few 360s to make sure we all saw it at its best post-sunset as we motored home) made this a first class experience. Thank you Sail Darwin!

Captain Alex and the team will certainly make your night a memorable one! Loved every minute, and the sunset itself was stunning as well.

The hospitality was incredible, the girls working on the boat made every effort to ensure everyone had everything they could need! I don’t think my glass ever reached empty 😂
They were also accommodating with food intolerances, when I let them know in advance. Highly recommend if you’re in Darwin!

Fantastic experience. My husband and I enjoyed every minute. Great food and drinks. Staff were friendly and efficient. Magic to be out on the water relaxing and enjoying the surrounds and sunset. Thank you for a wonderful evening in Darwin.
Cheers
Absolutely beautiful. We were made to feel very welcome and comfortable. Stunning views, nice nibbles and bottomless sparkling is true! Even got to pat the sea dog! Thank you for a great evening.

Absolutely fantastic cruise. One of the best in Australia. Fantastic food, vessel, music, all the sparkling wine you can drink, beautiful sunset, fantastic skipper. Great value for money. A must do when visiting Darwin!!!
Cannot recommend this highly enough! Great cruise, excellent crew, Awesome food (and plenty of it) I'll do this again when next in Darwin
Best thing to do in Darwin. Awesome crew, endless booze, and good food.
What an amazing experience my son and I had last night!!! Professional and lovely staff, the food was delicious and more than enough!!

Weather started off rough and wet but the experience of our skipper told us it would clear be and a spectacular sunset and it definitely was! Good food, wine and company. Too bad for those who decided to have a go at the crew and not get onboard. They missed out big time!

A Bacchanalian experience of the highest order. We have photos but we're away from home. So we'll update this review very soon.

Sunset in Darwin is superlative, but adding in the fantastic food from Fernando, the awesome aquatic abilities of Alex and the simply wonderful service and good humoured entertainment from Nisha and Tyler  made this Cruise something special. Book it. Book it now .

You will be swimming in sparkling wine, gasping from trays of haloumi, dips, smoked salmon, Scotch fillet, 8 course tapas menu? I reckon it was at least 12.

Something for everyone but perfect for lovers of all ages. No trip to Darwin is complete without this. A small local business very worthy of your custom

A must do in Darwin. We had a stormy Sunday afternoon cruise and it was absolutely amazing. I'd do this cruise again and again if I was a Darwin local. Lots of champagne and super tasty nibbles. The staff were such lovely people that contributed to the best evening.
Awesome 😀

Sail Darwin on their Sundancer is a must visit. Top notch service with special food for vegetarians too. Unlimited drinks too. The crew were extremely friendly turning the boat back when we had just missed it. Note the boat leaves from Dock 1
My 5 friends and I had the most enjoyable time on this sunset cruise. Staff were attentive and lovely. Food cooked on board, delicious and plentiful. Our champagne was  never empty. Highly recommend.
Delicious food, free flowing bubbles, lovely staff and a wonderful sunset!

Had a wonderful experience with genuine and fun hosts/hostesses, our “Skipper” avoided a storm looming and gave us just the most amazing view of the beauty and wonder Darwin delivers this time of year! Food and wine was EXCELLENT !! Highly recommend 🥂
Brillant. Great staff and service.

We had a fantastic time! The staff were very friendly and efficient in filling our glasses. Our glasses were always full! The food was delish and they catered very well for me as a vegetarian. Highly recommend!
Fantastic Trip with amazing staff. Drinks were never empty, food was amazing & everything was about the client. Highly recommend.
Fantastic cruise & experience. Location great, cruise so relaxing, staff very friendly & helpful & food superb. Must do when in Darwin.

Fantastic experience...food was great and plentiful (so was the sparkling white wine). Staff are brilliant and the view during the time on the water just gets better and better, cannot recommend enough.

I loved this tour, adults only and an intimate group. Staff are great and it's a fantastic perspective of Darwin from the water. Food and beverage tasty, worth the spend, in my opinion. Enjoyed stargazing on the way back to Port. A memorable souvenir of my Darwin trip.
Fantastic
Wonderful experience aboard the Sundancer for a 3hr sunset cruise, which was worth every dollar! Free flowing champagne, abundance of food and knowledgeable staff. Highly recommend.
Best sunset, free flowing bubbles and amazing food. Friendly staff and great value for money. Highly recommend

My husband booked us on their lunch cruise of Darwin harbour. It was aboard a 50ft catamaran. The sail was relaxing, comfortable and thoroughly enjoyable. The captain was very friendly and informative.  The staff were very attentive and took wonderful care of everyone on board. The food and drinks were ample and varied. All in all, a wonderful way to take in the sights & sounds and explore Darwin harbour. Would happily recommend this experience to anyone. Even if you tend to get seasick, this is a very calm, gentle and relaxing sail.

Had an amazing experience on the champagne sunset sail with Sail Darwin. The service and food was top quality and we were taken to a gorgeous and private spot in the mangroves to watch the sunset. I'm a Darwin local and would recommend anyone who comes to Darwin to do this activity!

What an amazing experience. It started with David (I think) on the phone when we wanted to try find something that wasn’t booked out. His service and politeness was over the top and pretty much sold us instantly. He recommended the lunch time booking. Oh boy…. This would be the first thing I would recommend to anyone coming to Darwin, the staff onboard were amazing. They were practically at your finger tips the entire journey and we’re happy to have a conversation at any point and make sure your glass was never empty! What an experience. Would happily fly up here to do the exact same trip again without a doubt.
Love the food. Staff was very accommodating. Skipper was friendly. And me and my husband LOVE THEIR PLAYLIST 👌🏻
The food was really good and plenty of it. The staff were really happy and friendly and ensured our drinks stayed full. Gorgeous sunset and a great experience.
Best time, highly recommended.
The sunset cruise was the most amazing experience ever. Crew was super friendly and attentive. Food and champagne was delicious and  the sunset was amazing !!
Don’t miss this!! Faultless - loved every minute. Endless flow of champagne and delicious tapas. Our hosts couldn’t do enough for us and well the sunsets 🌅… just stunning. A Darwin highlight!

The staff, food and experience were top notch!  I am vego and the staff went out of their way to give me different options. All of the food was really delicious and there was heaps of it.  While the weather was uncharacteristically cool and rainy for the wet season, the whole boat had a really great time. Definitely do this if you are in Darwin! (:
Had an amazing lunch time cruise! Such a great time, beautiful weather, good and drinks 😉🥂 All the staff were amazing! Thanks for a great time 👏👏👏
An absolutely epic sunset cruise, such attentive and fun staff, endless food and drinks (all inclusive) a fantastic vibe... A must-do when in Darwin!

A wonderful night fantastic cruise, great value for money. A very friendly crew. The food was more than ample and delicious, the bubbles endless and the sunset very beautiful. Would do it again.  Thank you.

Absolutely amazing 🤩
Would recommend this cruise to anyone coming to Darwin
The hospitality was great, the food and wine was fantastic, they kept your glass topped up and belly full
Great job guys, would definitely do this again 👍🏻

Wow ... what a night! 5 stars plus 5 stars. Fun, friendly, fantastic night! We ate we drank we sang and we had the best night. Our group of 10 all agree the staff were so attentive we couldn't have asked for more. Well done guys you've got the right blend of everything for a truly memorable night. Thanks from the Adelaide group.
We had so much fun on the day sail. I would recommend it. (I want to go again)

Absolutely amazing!
Had the best time with the most friendly staff and captain. Food was very tasty also.
Brilliant!!!
10/10… Amazing cruise, amazing food, amazing staff, amazing scenery.

6 of us set sail last Tuesday night on the Sail Darwin sunset 3 hour trip to celebrate our daughter’s admission as a lawyer and it was absolutely incredible. All the staff were generous, kind and genuine. The time went so quickly and not a drop of water was felt anywhere despite sitting close to the water on the comfy netting at the front of the catamaran. The staff also looked after our Grannie who at 83yo isn’t very mobile. She was spoilt rotten at the rear seating area and vowed to return again  (as will we…)! Just brilliant. Thank you.
The staff were amazing, food was great, catered for different dietary requirements, would recommend 1000% Thank you so much for the amazing experience!! ❤️❤️
Great food
Awesome night, great food, awesome crew. The whole crew make you feel welcome and make sure you are well fed and looked after.
Great music, great service, great food, zoe was a awesome. Missied the sunset but was still amazing
Went on Champagne Sunset Cruise. We had exceptional service from the friendly crew. Food was amazing and abundant above all expectations. A must do if in Darwin!
The crew made this one of the best experiences we have ever had! Cannot recommend this highly enough. Can’t wait to do it again my next visit! Thank you so much for such a fun time!

I had the best night on this Darwin Sunset Cruise Sunday 6th March 2022.  The weather perfect, the scenery perfect, the bubbles perfect, the food perfectly delicious,  the crew friendly, warm, the perfect hosts. I cant wait to do it again.  Loved it.

Our cruise was unfortunately cancelled at very short notice. It was disappointing that we were not offered an alternative booking. It was also unfortunate that we had wasted money on taxi fares to get to the wharf. We accept that sometimes mechanical failures will occur but felt that the communication was inadequate.

We were disappointed we could only give 5 stars bc this is a 6 star experience! The crew were friendly & super attentive (never were our glasses empty), awesome sunset & great food. Thank you for excellent evening highly recommended.
One of the best Darwin experiences there is!

Excellent value for money. The Chef freshly cooked lots of delicious  food to eat the whole cruise and the waitresses did an amazing job serving us and keeping glasses topped up with bubbles and taking photos for us. A lovely friendly atmosphere on board amongst all the passengers and we had a lovely sunset. I would highly recommend this cruise. Very well done. Thankyou.

Had a fantastic night. Food was on point and lots of variety, Wine glass was never empty and the crew was fantastic. It is exactly what we expected and more. If you are looking for a great night out in Darwin with fantastic food, lots of wine and an amazing sunset this is the one for you.
Adored the food, music, vibes, the whole lot. Will do it again for sure!
An absolutely fantastic experience! The staff were extremely lovely and accommodating. Plenty of food and drinks to go around. Cannot recommend enough!

Hands down the best sunset cruise in the NT.
Endless champagne, delicious food and fantastic staff. Thank you for an amazing evening 👌👌👌

Fabulous sunset cruise, good value, food was 👌, staff are very friendly
Highly recommend this cruise while in Darwin

Enjoyed the 3 hour sunset cruise. Alex and his crew were fantastic the drinks flowed continuously and the chef excelled with his non stop culinary offerings. Wonderful experience not to be passed over

Amazing experience! Great value for money and the crew are very friendly and professional. They are also accommodating of dietary requirements (e.g. vegan). For anyone visiting Darwin, I highly recommend including this in your itinerary.
Very friendly great food easy to move around in the boat
Went on this catamaran last night and was the highlight of our trip. We had the best time, great music, good food, plenty of champagne and of course an amazing sunset. Highly recommended.

The best sunset I have experienced in Darwin. It is so worth it's money probably more. The best service/crew ever and I definitely will be coming back for another evening. 10/10 for sail Darwin ❤️❤️❤️❤️ my parents from interstate said it was better then the last sunset cruise we were on last time and I agree with them. Keep up the great work with your beautiful tapas and unlimited champagne experience. beautiful people 😍🌅
Crew friendly ,food so so. Bubbles is Seaview Brut,  Luxury catamaran definitely not.  Would have been better had the crew introduced themselves on boarding
Brilliant cruise, great food,  staff were amazing

Don’t visit Darwin without going on this sunset cruise.
+ Amazing well maintained sailing vessel.
+  Safe and professionally run.
+ Much more fun and more enjoyable than a boring dinner cruise.
+ Lots of drinks including and yummy hors d’oeuvres.

Kudos to our bearded skipper,  Terry and the other stews for looking after everyone so well.

Fantastic cruise I highly recommend. I took my 92 year old father on this cruise and he loved it. As an old yachty he was happy to be back on the water. The cat was awesome and very spacious and comfortable. The skipper was very friendly and amazing at his job. The staff worked hard all night and you never wanted for anything. Rocky the chef kept us fed with beautiful food. I could not fault anything and would highly recommend this cruise. Great work guys!
10/10. A fabulous experience. So relaxed. Service staff were such fun, food was excellent, boat wonderful. And Darwin sunsets, well.... Do it.
Can't wait to travel again
Amazing experience, amazing sunset, great staff!
What a fantastic night.  Best cruise ever. Staff were so lovely. Thanks guys for a great time.
Absolutely Amazing !! The staff were beautiful people. The boat was incredible! The food, the service, the view, everything about this sunset cruise was amazing. Highly recommend it ! 🙂

We had the very best time for my husband's birthday doing this sunset cruise. Fantastic crew (hello Chilean friends) and scrumptious food and plenty of it and endless bubbly. We felt safe in the skipper's hands. Under sail during sunset with good music and everyone happy and chatting, what more could you ask for?

We had a wonderful time aboard Sundancer for the evening. The sunset view from this vantage point out on the water is amazing. The food and drinks kept coming all evening, from city views right up to Mindil Beach.  The crew were great, the whole thing was excellent and highly recommended.

If you want to spend a wonderful evening taking in the beauty of Darwin's coastline and sunset while enjoying great food prepared by a talented and funny chef, champagne, and the light social chat served up by a wonderful crew of attentive and friendly young people, this is the sail for you! This was our 3rd sunset sail this year, and each time has been a session of pampering, laughter and beautiful memories to take home. Special mention must be made of Kerry our hostess, and Jack our skipper, who both made this sail so enjoyable. Their friendly interaction, information sharing and attention to ensuring our time with them was comfortable and relaxing made for a great escape from the 'noise' of life, if only for a few hours. Well done David on having such a great team and sharing your catamaran with us to show off Darwin to our visitors - an indulgent experience for all.

What an experience. In an age where service is a hard commodity to find, the crew aboard the Sundancer proved to be attentive, informative, and helpful, all with a smile and enthusiasm you only dream of.
Copious quantities of champagne, 7 course tapas all served in a timely manner with the highest quality of food. I have to mention the music was Brilliant! Getting everyone in the mood for fun. Warm balmy breezes in pristine water, looking at the Darwin skyline while sailing with a glass of champagne good music, and food is an experience you don't want to miss.
The Sunset was spectacular!!

Highly recommended
We had a wonderful evening cruise. Relaxed, fun, great music choices and excellent food and generous supply of bubbly. Lovely hostesses. I highly recommend it for a treat / special evening.

Very good experience and wonderfull food and service, would love to thank Dave and the crew for such an awesome experience.  First sunset cruise in Darwin would highly recommend to anyone not looking at $$$ but at experience and memorable memories.  As for the comment saying could done half the price... Go do it, I know where I will email going next time - unbiased review 5 stars.
A beautiful sunset sailing experience. Definitely a 'must do' in Darwin. Great crew, friendly and knowledgable, and amazing value...
The sunset champagne dinner cruise is the best thing in the world and you have to do it.

We wanted a sailing experience on Darwin Waters as Sail Darwin promoted. Just as we boarded the catamaran & were leaving the marina we were told there will be no sailing as a part was needed to set the sails so only motorised cruising. We could have done this for half the price on another boat. No part refund offered either or option to leave the boat for a full refund. Very spicy food offered too which was disappointing. Make sure you check with the operators before boarding to be assured everything is as offered!
